body:
## Quick answer

You can buy Indian clothes online from **Bahe Kurtiz** in Jaipur and have them delivered to Canada with **free express shipping and duties included** – nothing extra to pay on delivery. Ready sizes are dispatched in 7–10 working days and arrive about 5–10 business days later; every style can be stitched to your measurements at no extra cost.

## Sizes in Canada

Canada uses US dress sizes: size 8 is about a 36-inch bust (an Indian M). Use the [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) or choose free custom fit.

## What to wear in Canada

Canadian winters are cold, so winter weddings and Diwali call for velvet or taffeta with thermals, closed shoes and a warm coat. Summer weddings in Toronto, Brampton or Vancouver can be hot – choose cotton or light georgette.

## Festivals and wedding season

Large Punjabi and Gujarati communities in the Greater Toronto Area and British Columbia mean busy summer wedding seasons, Navratri garba nights in the autumn and Vaisakhi parades every spring. See the exact last order dates for upcoming festivals below and on our [festival calendar](/festival/).

faq.q: How long does delivery to Canada take?
faq.a: Ready sizes are dispatched in 7–10 working days and custom-fit pieces in 10–15 working days; express delivery then takes about 5–10 business days, with tracking.

faq.q: Will I pay customs duty in Canada?
faq.a: No. We ship duties-paid (DDP), so duties and taxes are included and there is nothing to pay on delivery.

faq.q: Which currency will I pay in?
faq.a: Prices are in US dollars. Your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts it to Canadian dollars.

faq.q: What if my size is not standard?
faq.a: Choose free custom fit and send your bust, waist, hip and height – we stitch the outfit to your measurements at no extra cost, up to size 3XL (4XL in our linen & velvet styles).
